item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-128637cf2d7d3eed","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The source describes the Xi Jinping administration as combining performance-based legitimacy and effective governance with intensified suppression of dissent, including political persecution and pressure on civil society; it presents this as a continuing authoritarian governance pattern rather than a documented 2023 event.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Context for 2023; the source was published in 2018 and does not establish a change during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The discussion concerns the Xi Jinping administration and CCP Party-State policies.","limitations":["The passage is a scholarly foreword synthesizing cited material and does not provide direct 2023 measurements.","Some claims concern earlier periods or other Chinese regions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-128637cf2d7d3eed","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The source reports that under the Xi Jinping administration religious security was elevated to the level of national security, religion was required to serve Party needs, and religious control was tightened through stricter rules and regulations.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.7","4B.3","4B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Context for 2023; the source was published in 2018 and describes an established policy direction rather than a 2023-specific decision.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the policy line to the Xi Jinping administration and CCP leadership.","limitations":["The passage is an authorial synthesis and does not quantify implementation in 2023.","It does not distinguish Xi's personal order from broader CCP policy mechanisms."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e93f03d83f952f96","start_unit":4,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Since the early 2010s, CCP committees expanded and institutionalized classified consultative-information channels that regularly solicited reports from academics and professionals outside government and Party institutions; the system was designed to obtain higher-quality and more critical policy proposals, while criticism remained subject to limits.","question_ids":["8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Applicable as background to 2023 because the article describes a system operating under the Xi administration, but the evidence is primarily historical and institutional rather than a 2023 observation.","ruler_attribution":"The article attributes the expansion to the CCP under the Xi administration and to local Party committees responding to central demands.","limitations":["The system is classified and the evidence is based on qualitative interviews and archival/public-document triangulation.","The source does not establish that every consultation materially changed policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e93f03d83f952f96","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The article finds that the central CCP diversified information sources because internal information agencies could be slow, biased by conflicts of interest, or obstructed from reporting problems; academics were sought as relatively more analytical and objective sources, but career and monetary incentives increasingly aligned their output with CCP political needs.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.4","8B.8","4B.5","7B.5"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Applicable to 2023 as an institutional pattern established since the early 2010s; not a discrete 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns central and local CCP institutions operating under Xi Jinping's administration.","limitations":["The source reports interview-based findings and does not provide a representative quantitative measure of bias or policy improvement.","Alignment incentives may increase access to expertise while reducing independence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e93f03d83f952f96","start_unit":11,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"After the 2019 Central CCP General Office information forum, consultative-information performance became a high-stakes evaluation criterion for local Party committees and departments; Yinchuan required each department to submit at least 20 reports monthly, with points for acceptance and senior-leader instructions, while Guangdong reportedly weighted the activity at one-fourth of local government evaluation.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Applicable in 2023 as a continuing administrative evaluation mechanism documented by the study.","ruler_attribution":"The mechanism is attributed to central CCP General Office pressure and local CCP implementation under the Xi administration.","limitations":["Examples are local and may not generalize nationally.","The evidence shows reporting and evaluation activity, not necessarily successful policy outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e93f03d83f952f96","start_unit":17,"end_unit":19,"fact_summary":"University consultative reports accepted by municipal or higher-level agencies averaged a 48.52% acceptance share from 2011–2019; accepted reports increased from 4,562 in 2011 to 11,539 in 2019, while total university reports rose from 8,166 to 25,805. One Shenzhen private-think-tank report received Xi Jinping's instruction and helped set the basis for the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macau Greater Bay Area development plan.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The quantitative results end in 2019; the Xi instruction and resulting planning relevance provide pre-2023 institutional context but do not measure 2023 outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The article specifically attributes the Greater Bay Area instruction to Xi Jinping and the broader reporting expansion to the Xi administration.","limitations":["Acceptance does not prove implementation or effectiveness.","The quantitative series predates 2023 and the article does not provide a 2023 update."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e93f03d83f952f96","start_unit":22,"end_unit":26,"fact_summary":"From 2013 onward, consultative information was incorporated into academics' evaluations, promotions, research funding, and talent schemes; some institutions awarded up to 100,000 yuan for reports receiving Politburo Standing Committee instructions. The article concludes that this expanded policy access but also tied academics more closely to Party needs and left less room for independent research in politically sensitive fields.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.5","8B.4"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Applicable to 2023 as a continuing institutional practice documented under the Xi administration.","ruler_attribution":"The article attributes the policies to the CCP, State Council, ministries, and research institutions during the Xi administration.","limitations":["The evidence combines institutional rules, interviews, and cited reports; it does not quantify the effect on policy quality.","The passage does not establish Xi's personal involvement in each academic evaluation rule."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3baf0f1fff68f198","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 20 September 2023, a UN special-procedures communication concerning China reported information about widespread separation of Uyghur children from their parents in Xinjiang, identifying one alleged victim.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","4B.7","6B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023 because the communication was sent on 20 September 2023, although the summary does not specify the dates of the alleged separations.","ruler_attribution":"The communication concerns alleged conduct by Chinese authorities; it does not establish a personal order by Xi Jinping.","limitations":["This is an allegation recorded in a UN communication, not a final adjudicative finding.","The supplied summary provides no details on scale, responsible officials, or government response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ba2487bd3770bb50","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 17 March 2023, a UN special-procedures communication reported information concerning multiple cases against Jimmy Lai under various legal provisions, including China's National Security Law, involving alleged arbitrary detention and restrictions on expression, peaceful assembly, association, and judicial independence.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.4","4B.9","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023 because the communication was sent on 17 March 2023 and concerns an ongoing legal case.","ruler_attribution":"The communication concerns Chinese legal and security authorities; it does not establish a personal directive by Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The summary records information received by UN experts and does not constitute a final finding.","The supplied text does not state the outcome of the proceedings or any response by Chinese authorities."]},{"source_id":"SRC-72f8a8b6f8d226f9","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 26 June 2023, a UN special-procedures communication reported the arrest and alleged prolonged arbitrary detention of two Tibetan Buddhist monks and alleged arbitrary detention and enforced disappearances of four other Tibetan Buddhists in connection with religion, expression, and cultural rights.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","3B.7","4B.3","4B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023 because the communication was sent on 26 June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The communication concerns alleged conduct by Chinese authorities; it does not identify a personal Xi Jinping order.","limitations":["The summary records allegations and does not constitute a final adjudicative finding.","It provides no information about investigation, remedy, or official response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b66f850213283b9c","start_unit":1,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 24 October 2023, China's Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Civil Affairs allocated a second 2023 central-budget subsidy tranche for temporary price assistance to low-income and vulnerable groups, including low-income households, people in extreme poverty, orphans, unsupported children, and children living with HIV; local finance and civil-affairs departments were instructed to distribute the funds promptly.","question_ids":["5B.9","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023 because the allocation and implementation instruction were issued on 24 October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The measure was formally issued by the central Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Civil Affairs under the Chinese state administration; the supplied document does not identify Xi's personal role.","limitations":["The supplied text omits the attachment containing regional allocation amounts.","It demonstrates funding and administrative direction, not completed delivery or measured welfare effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6921a290af5450d6","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Shanghai authorities approved a one-time 60-yuan January 2023 price subsidy per person for low-income-assistance recipients, people in extreme poverty, low-income households, orphans, and children in difficult circumstances, with payment required by 28 February 2023 through district-controlled or direct bank-account channels and reporting into an information system.","question_ids":["5B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023 because the subsidy covered January 2023 and the notice required payment by 28 February 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The measure was approved and administered by Shanghai municipal and district civil-affairs and finance authorities; the document does not identify Xi's personal role.","limitations":["The document establishes a formal local program and deadline, not verified completion or incidence.","It is one municipality and cannot establish national coverage."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-619601ea71f83bb9","SRC-44d43c82a34b3ba3","SRC-a21feff97bbe9916","SRC-af86347b84ab2af2","SRC-9add00c87d66f6ac"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied sources expose only metadata, page navigation, or a title without substantive document content; no material fact was inferred from those sources.","The evidence set is uneven across chapters and often reports institutional patterns, allegations, or policy inputs rather than verified 2023 outcomes.","No scores were assigned."]}
